goal: Review a large codebase for personal data handling using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition: where…
use: Review a large codebase for personal data handling using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition: where personal data is collected, stored, logged, shared with third parties and retained, with a data inventory and gaps. Use for privacy reviews, data-protection impact assessments, or when asked where personal data goes.

steps.note: Map. For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees the chunk and the "Chunk task" below.
Trace. For each data element in the inventory, follow its path through the code: collection, storage, logging, transfer, deletion.
Verify. Open each cited file and line, confirm each finding against the source, and drop any finding you cannot confirm.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo>`. Narrow the scope with `--include` if the repository is very large, and record what was skipped.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees the chunk and the "Chunk task" below. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"` and process the first listed chunk, then run `pending` again until nothing is pending.

protocol.title: Trace
protocol.text: For each data element in the inventory, follow its path through the code: collection, storage, logging, transfer, deletion. Confirm the path by reading the code, not by name alone.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: Open each cited file and line, confirm each finding against the source, and drop any finding you cannot confirm.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: Write the report in the format below.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the report is delivered.
